title: Memanto memory
description: Memanto-backed project memory for the GSD lifecycle. Fails closed: a blocking gate halts the workflow when the configured Memanto agent or endpoints are not healthy.
author: The Artificer of Ciphers LLC

memanto.enabled.description: Enables the Memanto capability for this project; only the boolean true activates it.

memanto.agent_id.description: The Memanto agent id this project reads and writes; it must be set explicitly, and an empty value blocks every gate.

memanto.backend_url.description: Full URL with scheme of the pre-running Memanto backend; an empty value blocks every gate.

memanto.api_url.description: Full URL with scheme of the pre-running Memanto REST API; an empty value blocks every gate.

predicate.command:
exec node -e 'const p=require("path"),f=require("fs"),h=process.env.GSD_HOME||require("os").homedir(),b=".gsd/capabilities/memanto",g="(memanto.enabled=false disables Memanto for this project)
",s=(x)=>String(x).slice(0,150).replace(/[\s\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]+/g," ");const no=(m)=>{process.stderr.write("memanto: BLOCKED [gate-bundle] "+m+"
"+g);process.exit(1)};const j=(x)=>{if(!f.statSync(x).isFile())throw 0;return JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(x,"utf8"))};const ok=(r)=>{try{const e=j(p.join(r,".gsd-capabilities.json")).entries.memanto;return !!e&&typeof e==="object"&&!(Object.hasOwn(e,"_pending"))&&e.id==="memanto"&&typeof e.version==="string"&&typeof e.source==="string"&&typeof e.integrity==="string"&&Array.isArray(e.files)&&Array.isArray(e.sharedEdits)&&j(p.join(r,b,"capability.json")).id==="memanto"}catch{return false}};let r=".";if(f.existsSync(p.join(h,b,"capability.json"))){if(!ok(h))no(s(p.join(h,b))+" holds a capability.json but no committed entry in "+s(p.join(h,".gsd-capabilities.json"))+"; gsd-core loads that copy, so the gate never falls back to a project copy -> delete that directory by hand (gsd-tools capability remove cannot remove an unledgered copy), or reinstall: gsd-tools capability install npm:@taoc/gsd-memanto@0.1.0 --yes");r=h}else if(!ok("."))no("no installed memanto bundle (capability.json plus a committed ledger entry) in ${GSD_HOME:-$HOME} or this project -> reinstall: gsd-tools capability install npm:@taoc/gsd-memanto --yes");try{require(p.resolve(r,b,"scripts/gate.cjs"))}catch(e){process.stderr.write("memanto: BLOCKED [gate-internal] "+s(e&&e.message||e)+" -> reinstall memanto, then run its memanto.cjs doctor
"+g);process.exit(1)}'
